description: Grant another wallet time-bounded access to specified memory entries. Returns grant receipt; immutable consent row written. Compliance: GDPR Art. 7, 32. Cost $0.01 per call.

categories.description: Non-empty list of categories the grantee may read.

entity_id.description: Entity whose memory the grant covers.

entity_type.description: Entity type of the granted memory.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 expiry (max 730 days from now).

grantee_did.description: Optional DID stored for audit alongside the grantee wallet.

grantee_wallet.description: 0x-prefixed wallet that will be allowed to read.

wallet_signature.description: EIP-191 signature of the grantor over the grant message.

name: memory.grant

consent_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical consent payload.

ok.description: True when the tool completed without a validation error.

payment.description: Settlement receipt after x402 or sandbox payment.

tool.description: Tool name that produced this payload.

title: Memory Grant
